The Met Collection

The Met Collection

Journey across time and cultures through more than 534,000 works of art in The Met's online collection. Spanning thousands of years of human creativity, the collection includes records of the earliest writing, works made as recently as last year, entire architectural experiences including a monumental temple from ancient Egypt, tiny treasures, and so much more.
